title: Resolve ghosted-request attribution across hosted/dedicated/private metering pipelines
creator: Maya Chen
description: Several enterprise customers reported inexplicable invoice line items and usage spikes after recent multi-region failover. Investigation shows a class of 'ghosted' requests where retries, cache-replays, and a race in the metering pipeline cause events to be emitted without a matching request attribution ID. This ticket tracks the triage, a safe short-term mitigation for billing correctness, and the durable fix in the hosted/dedicated/private metering paths.
repro_steps: Simulate a request to hosted API with client retry enabled and network partition to region A
Trigger model fallback to a cheaper variant in region B via smart routing policy
Introduce a KV cache warmup while request in-flight to force cache-replay path
Observe metering event stream in staging: duplicated token events with missing request_id and mismatched deployment tags
root_cause_summary: A combination of (1) asynchronous batching acknowledgements, (2) the replay path that emits metering events when KV cache warms, and (3) a race where request_id is dropped during fallback routing creates orphaned metering events. These events get picked up by the billing aggregator and attributed to an internal null tenant, causing spike and reconciliation issues across Hosted/Dedicated/Private modes.
mitigation: Deploy short-lived filter in ingestion pipeline to drop metering events with null or malformed request_id (hotfix) - rolled to hosted and dedicated on 2026-03-05
Add temporary billing credit for affected customers while root cause investigation continues (billing ops ticket BILL-1122)
Add feature flag guard to disable cache-replay metering emissions until fix is deployed
acceptance_criteria: No orphaned metering events observed in staging for synthetic workloads that previously reproduced the issue
Billing aggregation tests show parity within 0.1% versus golden dataset for 24h window in staging
E2E test for request_id propagation passes across hosted, dedicated, and private emulation runs
PR with durable fix merged and deployed to canary, and hotfix filter removed behind flag
next_steps: Design durable fix: ensure request_id is propagated and persisted before any async batching or fallback logic (owner: Luis Ortega, ETA 3 days)
Update metering schema to include source_tag and fallback_origin to enable precise attribution (owner: Priya Nair)
Implement replay path guardrails to attach original_request_id from routing context
Create post-deploy monitoring dashboard and alert: orphaned_event_rate > 0.01% triggers P1
